questions.description: 用嵌套循环打印 3x3 星号矩阵。
打印 1 到 5 的阶乘表。
questions.code_template:
fact = 1
for i in range(1, 6):
    fact *= i
    print(___)
questions.solution:
fact = 1
for i in range(1, 6):
    fact *= i
    print(f"{i}! = {fact}")

questions.description: 输出 1 到 10 中 3 的倍数。
求 1 到 50 中偶数的平方和。
用 for 生成斐波那契前 10 项。
questions.code_template:
fib = [0, 1]
for i in range(2, 10):
    fib.append(fib[i - 1] + fib[i - 2])
print(___)
questions.solution:
fib = [0, 1]
for i in range(2, 10):
    fib.append(fib[i - 1] + fib[i - 2])
print(fib)

questions.description: 统计字符串中每个字母出现次数。

reversed_nums = []
for n in nums:
    reversed_nums.insert(0, n)
print(___)
questions.solution:
nums = [1, 2, 3, 4]

questions.description: 打印数字三角形（递加）。
求两个列表的对应元素乘积和。
questions.code_template:
a = [1, 2, 3]
b = [4, 5, 6]
total = 0
for x, y in zip(a, b):
    total += x * y
print(___)
questions.solution:
a = [1, 2, 3]
b = [4, 5, 6]
total = 0
for x, y in zip(a, b):
    total += x * y
print(f"Dot product: {total}")

questions.description: 用 for 找出列表中的重复元素。
questions.code_template:
nums = [1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3]
seen = set()
dupes = []
for n in nums:
    if n in seen and n not in dupes:
        dupes.append(n)
    seen.add(n)
print(___)
questions.solution:
nums = [1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3]
seen = set()
dupes = []
for n in nums:
    if n in seen and n not in dupes:
        dupes.append(n)
    seen.add(n)
print(dupes)

questions.description: 打印 5x5 棋盘（# 和 . 交替）。
求 1 到 n 的累加（for 版高斯）。
questions.code_template:
n = 100
total = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    total += i
print(___)
questions.solution:
n = 100
total = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    total += i
print(f"1+2+...+{n} = {total}")

questions.description: 把嵌套列表扁平化（for 版）。

筛选并输出质数（for 遍历）。

计算单词平均长度。
questions.code_template:
words = ["apple", "pear", "kiwi"]
total_len = 0
for w in words:
    total_len += len(w)
